arguments.old_string:
**Purpose:** DeepSeek-DSA-style sparse causal attention with rotary position embeddings. A lightning indexer (ReLU(q_idx·k_idx)/sqrt(index_dim)) ranks keys per query; the top `index_top_k` keys (the most recent `local_window` always forced in) form the attention support. Selected positions receive an additive bias of `index_gate * score` inside SDPA so the indexer trains end-to-end via attention gradients; everything else is masked to -inf. Sequences longer than `sparse_chunk_threshold` route to `forward_long`. Optionally adds a LoRA delta to the fused QKV output.

**Parameters:** `x: Tensor` (batch, seq, dim); `cos/sin: Tensor` — RoPE caches; `qkv_delta: Tensor | None` — LoRA contribution shaped (batch, seq, 3*dim) or None.

**Returns:** `Tensor` (batch, seq, dim).

**Side effects:** None.

**Raises:** Shape errors on malformed input.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `Block.forward`. Calls `Attention.project_heads`, `Attention.index_scores`, `select_sparse_indices`, `scaled_dot_product_attention`, `Attention.forward_long`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-11 — replaced dense causal SDPA with indexer-gated top-k sparse attention.
arguments.new_string:
**Purpose:** DeepSeek-DSA-style sparse causal attention with rotary position embeddings, consuming a precomputed `SparseSelection` from the model-level indexer. Routes by selection contents and hardware: long-context selections (no mask) go to `forward_long`; on CUDA with head_dim ≥ FLEX_MIN_HEAD_DIM the FlexAttention kernel path (`attend_short_flex`) is used, else the SDPA bias path (`attend_short_sdpa`). Selected positions receive the gated indexer score as an additive softmax bias; everything else is masked to -inf. Optionally adds a LoRA delta to the fused QKV output.

**Parameters:** `x: Tensor` (batch, seq, dim); `cos/sin: Tensor` — RoPE caches; `qkv_delta: Tensor | None` — LoRA contribution shaped (batch, seq, 3*dim) or None; `selection: SparseSelection` — shared selection from `SparseIndexer`.

**Returns:** `Tensor` (batch, seq, dim).

**Side effects:** None.

**Raises:** Shape errors on malformed input.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `Block.forward`. Calls `Attention.attend_short_flex`, `Attention.attend_short_sdpa`, `Attention.forward_long`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-11 — selection now passed in from the shared indexer; flex/sdpa routing added.

### Attention.attend_short_flex — src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py

**Purpose:** FlexAttention implementation of the short sparse path: score_mod adds the precomputed gated indexer bias on selected positions and -inf elsewhere, running as one fused compiled kernel. Requires CUDA and head_dim ≥ 16 (FLEX_MIN_HEAD_DIM).

**Parameters:** As `Attention.forward` (x, cos, sin, qkv_delta, selection); selection must carry `selected`/`biased`.

**Returns:** `Tensor` (batch, seq, dim).

**Side effects:** First call compiles the flex kernel (cached module-global).

**Raises:** Inductor errors on unsupported shapes (head_dim < 16).

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `Attention.forward`. Calls `compiled_flex_attention`, `Attention.project_heads`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-11 — added for throughput.

### Attention.attend_short_sdpa — src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py

**Purpose:** SDPA implementation of the short sparse path: builds a dense additive bias (gated indexer score on selected positions, -inf elsewhere) and calls scaled_dot_product_attention with it. CPU / small-head fallback, and the numerical reference for the flex path.

**Parameters:** As `Attention.forward`; selection must carry `selected`/`biased`.

**Returns:** `Tensor` (batch, seq, dim).

**Side effects:** None.

**Raises:** Shape errors propagate.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `Attention.forward`, tests. Calls `scaled_dot_product_attention`, `Attention.project_heads`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-11 — extracted from the former single short path.
